name: restaurant-booking-system
description: Complete restaurant booking system: API server + staff dashboard + customer website with embeddable widget.

scripts.install:all: cd server && bun install && cd ../client && bun install && cd ../website && bun install
scripts.start:all: concurrently -n server,dashboard,website -c blue,magenta,green "bun run start:server" "bun run start:dashboard" "bun run start:website"
